تستهلين (form X)
# تَسْتَهِلِّينَ (tastahillīna) /tas.ta.hil.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَهَلَّ (istahalla)
# تُسْتَهَلِّينَ (tustahallīna) /tus.ta.hal.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَهَلَّ (istahalla)
